The named Z costocervical source parent is not added or bridged to the separately sourced BODY trunk. Intramuscular terminal branches are not modeled.

subset.modifications: Original compressed triangles, material attributes, source name, identifier and Z frame retained; only package tables and byte offsets compacted. Reviewed side and region metadata added; ordinary arterial layer visibility remains enabled.
subset.scope: Right deep cervical artery only; left original already mounted. No reconstructed parent bridge or terminal muscular arteriole.
